newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiwabo sees special loss from units' dissolusion.
newsitem.headline: Daiwabo sees special loss from units' dissolusion.

text.p: Daiwabo Co Ltd said on Thursday that it would include an extraordinary loss of 5.86 billion yen in its parent earnings for the year to March 31, 1997, as three of its units will be dissolved, but it added that it would maintain its earnings forecast for 1996/97.
The textile maker plans a special profit to offset the expected special loss, Daiwabo said.
Special profits usually come from the sale of land or other assets, but the company would not say where the special profit would come from.
The units include Takase Dyeing & Printing Works, Daiwabo said.
Takase said on Thursday that it planned to start procedures to dissolve itself early next year due to severe competition.
The other two Daiwabo units are unlisted.
